transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since that accident at the warehouse, I can’t get a full night’s sleep and I wake up over and over, completely drained the next day. I just feel so exhausted all the time and really need some help.
Have you been experiencing any recurring, distressing memories or flashbacks of the accident at the warehouse?

Yes, it's like a movie clip that keeps popping up in my head all day, even when I'm just trying to watch TV. I keep seeing the shelf tilting, the crash, and the blood soaking through my hands, which makes my heart pound and my stomach flip like I'm right back in that aisle.
Have you been avoiding people, places, or activities that remind you of the accident at the warehouse?

Yes, I've been avoiding certain aisles at the warehouse entirely, and I absolutely dread my shift changes. I've also stopped going on hikes and volunteering at the food pantry because I just feel too exhausted, anxious, and emotionally disconnected from everything.
Do you find yourself constantly on the lookout for potential dangers or threats, even when you're in a safe environment, like at home or with friends?

Yes, I'm constantly on edge and scanning my surroundings for danger. At home, I find myself scanning the room and tensing up at every little noise, and at work, I'm always checking the racks above me and jumping whenever a pallet drops.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, such as the flashbacks, avoidance, and constant lookout for dangers, since the accident at the warehouse?
All of these symptoms started right after the shelving accident at the warehouse about three weeks ago. It has been going on pretty much nonstop every single day since then.
You mentioned these symptoms started about three weeks ago, can you tell me if they have been consistently severe since then or have you noticed any fluctuations in their intensity?
They have been consistently severe without any real let-up since the day it happened. I haven't noticed any fluctuations at all—it has just been nonstop and intense every single day.
